lines.text: Rehoboam goes to Shechem, where Israel asks him to lighten the heavy yoke Solomon put on them.
Rehoboam tells the people to return in three days, then asks the elders, who advise serving the people kindly.
Rehoboam rejects the elders and asks the young men, who say to add to the yoke and scourge with scorpions.
Rehoboam answers harshly, Israel goes home, and after Israel stones Adoram, Rehoboam escapes by chariot to Hebron.
Israel makes Jeroboam king, and Rehoboam gathers 120,000 warriors, but the LORD tells him through Shemaiah to return home.
